summary.suggested: The St. Louis Evening Dispatch carried an ad for Tom Allen's Free and Easy at 417 Washington Avenue, calling it the best and coolest place of amusement in the city, with the latest songs nightly and the champion keeping order.

metadata.notes: No page image; date and paper unverified. Filed as Post-Dispatch, which did not exist until 1878-12; renamed per rubric assuming it is a Dispatch item.

facts.fact: Allen advertised his Free and Easy at 417 Washington Avenue, St. Louis, with songs every night and himself keeping order
